name: Gray-Gradient Mode Histogram Clustering Transfer Function
aliases: Automatic Transfer Function using Gray-Gradient Mode Histogram
definition: A method for automatically generating a volume rendering transfer function by embedding volume data attributes (gray and gradient) into a two-dimensional histogram, performing hierarchical clustering analysis on the histogram's spatial information to extract curve peaks, and mapping these results to color, opacity, and gradient multiplier functions.
summary: This method automatically generates volume rendering transfer functions by clustering gray-gradient histograms to assign uniform colors and enhance tissue boundaries, avoiding the blurring of standard interpolation.
